pastPresentFuture.mdLayoutDescription:
# Past, Present, Future

The **Past, Present, Future** layout is a way to ask the cards about how the past, present, and future affect the subject of the question - the subject could be a person, a place, an event, or any other identified *entity*.

[Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/).
